name: concrete-answers
description: Forces every answer to name the real thing: a file path, a symbol, a command that was run, a business entity, a module that exists in this repo. Bans stand-in labels the user never wrote (`$1.1`, "step 2", "the module in question") and the filler abstractions that make a report readable but unverifiable ("optimized the logic", "improved robustness"). Also governs how that answer is built: conclusion first, verbs instead of noun stacks, and a recommendation instead of a menu of options. Also applies to summaries relayed from a subagent: a generic summary gets specifics fetched, not passed on. One resident CLAUDE.md block plus a skill holding the long form.
